protocol: 2026-10-27 targeted development regression, not heldout or population accuracy. Judge against fetched Busan official 1757816 and official service originals. S=sufficient, P=partial, C=clarification, I=insufficient, W=wrong, E=error. C/I must not be added to sufficient answers. Each scenario has its own cookie session; follow-ups share it. Keep local Ollama/Gemma4 and production rate limit.

Same 2026 event date for spacing and short year variants
No unsupported 2024 dates; year-only correction retains event and new year in time follow-up
Do not substitute 2026 for unsupported 2027 notice
Current date 2026-10-27: 내년 means 2027; don't use 2026
No Gamcheon dates for a different requested festival
Official public health centre general hours; no festival contamination
Ask audience first; adult response must not recommend child-only booking
Dedicated official staff directory; correct direct number vs fax
Replace 괴정2동 with 신평1동 while retaining small-library scope
